_doc: Infected tiers (the 7 Days feral/radiated idea in our fiction): how far the Bloom has taken a Hollowed. Multipliers apply on top of the world settings. Tiers are rolled per spawn from the gamestage brackets below (highest bracket with gs <= gamestage), unless the world setting infected_tiers is off. Glow drives the std_surface bloom_glow instance uniform (pale filaments under the skin). loot_tier is the loot tier their remains roll at.

sleeper_tier_bonus._doc: Authored sleepers keep their type but roll a tier at the POI's tier + this many gamestage points per POI tier.
